title: SLP-Bench: Evaluating and Improving Acoustic Claims of Reasoning Audio Language Models on Clinical Speech
abstract: arXiv:2611.27810v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Audio language models (ALMs) can answer clinical questions from speech, outperforming baselines built on handcrafted acoustic features. Reasoning ALMs generate a chain of thought that refers to properties of the speaker's voice before predicting. Each statement the model makes about the voice needs to be checked against clinicians' perceptual ratings of the same recording. On clinical speech, existing evaluations score only the final answer. We introduce Speech Language Pathologist Bench (SLP-Bench), a benchmark grading each acoustic claim in the chain of thought against clinicians' perceptual ratings of the same recording. It covers five clinician-rated datasets and 25 perceptual dimensions, and assesses claims for factuality, stability under resampling, and consistency across reworded and different questions. translated_title: SLP-Bench：评估与改进推理型音频语言模型在临床语音上的声学论断
translated_abstract: 音频语言模型能够根据语音回答临床问题，其表现优于基于手工设计声学特征的基线方法。推理型音频语言模型在给出预测之前，会生成一条涉及说话人嗓音属性的思维链。模型对嗓音做出的每一项陈述，都需要与临床医生对同一录音的感知评分进行核对。然而在临床语音领域，现有评估方法仅对最终答案进行打分。我们提出了言语语言病理学家基准，这是一个将思维链中的每一项声学论断与临床医生对同一录音的感知评分进行逐条对照评分的基准。该基准涵盖五个由临床医生评分的数据集和25个感知维度，并从事实准确性、重采样下的稳定性，以及改写问题与不同问题之间的一致性等方面评估这些论断。在对十个开源权重推理型音频语言模型进行零样本评估中，论断的平衡准确率介于0.52至0.58之间，论断会在……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出SLP-Bench基准，将推理型音频语言模型思维链中的每一项声学论断与临床医生的感知评分逐条对照，评估其事实性、稳定性和一致性，结果显示十个开源模型的论断平衡准确率仅为0.52至0.58。
en_tdlr: SLP-Bench is a benchmark that grades every acoustic claim in reasoning audio language models' chains of thought against clinicians' perceptual ratings of clinical speech, revealing that ten open-weight models achieve only 0.52–0.58 claim balanced accuracy.
